name: ftell-on-a-socket-returns-espipe
description: elephc's ftell() answers 29 (ESPIPE) on a non-seekable stream where php answers the logical byte count — the lseek probe's failure is never checked
metadata:
  type: project
---

```php
[$a, $b] = stream_socket_pair(STREAM_PF_UNIX, STREAM_SOCK_STREAM, 0);
ftell($a);          // php: 0 puis 5, 11 … | elephc: 29, TOUJOURS 29
```

**MESURÉ** sur `php -n` 8.5.6 (probe `socket-pair-shapes` du balayage) : php tient une position
LOGIQUE sur un flux non-repositionnable = octets lus+écrits.

| | php | elephc |
|---|---|---|
| frais | 0 | 29 |
| ap
